Title: Reliable diving, two-hand shotgun and Windows update repair
Changes: Nori now holds the shotgun with both hands. Its muzzle follows the firing direction while swimming or standing.
Shotgun kick is much gentler and cannot accumulate with attack-speed upgrades. Swimming keeps full directional control while firing.
Dive input brings you back through the surface. Weapon recoil and currents no longer accumulate into vertical swimming speed.
Coastal walls no longer lift swimmers above the sea through the seabed fallback.
Co-op players see the shotgun aim and firing pose. Everyone in a session must use this updated version.
Fixed installed updates failing at Handoff in Program Files. Earlier affected versions need the standalone installer once; future updates use the repaired updater.
Update failures now include the helper's actual error details.
